large: Create a faithful pixel-art character reference for a side-view underwater Pokemon game. One horizontal row: Oshawott, Dewott, and original Unovan Samurott, all full-body facing right in a slightly front-facing three-quarter swimming pose. References 1,2,3 show their original anatomy and shell designs; reference4 shows Samurott's actual shell blade and grip. Target logical body sizes 48/64/96 pixels respectively, displayed enlarged with the same integer pixel zoom. Coarse square pixel clusters, limited flat palette, consistent dark thin outline. POSES: Oshawott holds its single detached segmented belly shell in one visible white paw, other white paw visible and empty, belly bare. Shell is original central panel with side segments and lower tab, not a generic radial scallop. Dewott has BOTH original elongated segmented hip shells DRAWN, one in each of its TWO BLACK HANDS. Both hips are empty. Two blue arms each visibly connected from shoulder to black paw, two feet, no missing hands or additional limbs. Separate both hands and shells in silhouette: one hand slightly forward, the other to the side, hold shells away from torso so correct grip is readable. Shell shapes must match reference2, no invented handles or generic fan shells. Samurott has BOTH original shell swords DRAWN, one in each existing FRONT PAW. Exactly FOUR limbs total: two forelegs raised/bent holding swords, two hind legs trailing in swimming pose. Do not retain grounded forelegs and add arms. Both foreleg scabbards remain EMPTY, drawn blades are not duplicated on armor. Both paws use NORMAL FORWARD grips, thumb/index toward blade root, little finger toward grip butt; arms and wrists angle down so both long tapered cream blade tips point DOWNWARD, separated from body and each other. No reverse icepick grips, no ornamental crossguards, no drill-shaped blades. Match blade/grip in reference4. Original helmet horn stays attached. Generous transparent space around all subjects and full blade tips, no overlaps between characters. Genuine transparent background, no labels, no scene, no water effects, no glow or halo. One pose per character, character reference only, no animation strip.
